title: Draft Comprehensive README.md Structure
description: Create a detailed outline for the expanded README.md, covering all required sections such as project overview, features, tech stack, setup, environment variables, and deployment.
details: Review the PRD and repository analysis to determine all necessary sections. Structure the README with clear headings: About The Project, Key Features, Technology Stack, Getting Started (Prerequisites, Installation, Running Locally), Environment Variables, Deployment, and References. Ensure logical flow and completeness. Include placeholders for content to be filled in subsequent steps.
test_strategy: Peer review the outline for completeness and logical order. Confirm all required sections are present and clearly defined.

title: Populate README.md with Detailed Content
description: Fill in each section of the README.md with accurate, clear, and concise information based on the PRD, repository analysis, and best practices.
details: Write content for each section: summarize the project, list features, describe the tech stack, and provide step-by-step setup instructions. Reference official documentation for key technologies. Use Markdown formatting for readability. Add badges (e.g., license, build status) if applicable. Ensure language is accessible to new contributors.
test_strategy: Proofread for clarity and accuracy. Validate that all information is correct and up-to-date. Peer review for completeness.

title: Document Environment Variables and Update .env.example
description: List all required environment variables in the README and ensure .env.example is present and accurate.
details: Identify all environment variables needed for local development and production (e.g., database connection, Better Auth secrets). Document each variable in the README with explanations. Create or update .env.example to include all variables with placeholder values.
test_strategy: Test by setting up a new environment using only the README and .env.example. Confirm the app starts without missing variable errors.

title: Add Docker Deployment Instructions to README.md
description: Expand the README to include clear, step-by-step Docker-based deployment instructions.
details: Describe how to build and run the application using Docker and Docker Compose. Include commands for building images, running containers, and configuring environment variables for production. Reference any relevant files (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml).
test_strategy: Follow the documented steps on a clean clone to ensure successful Docker deployment. Peer review for clarity and completeness.

title: Validate and Finalize README.md Documentation
description: Test the onboarding process using the expanded README.md and .env.example to ensure accuracy and completeness.
details: Simulate a new developer experience: clone the repo, follow the README instructions, set up the environment, and run the app locally and via Docker. Note any missing or unclear steps and revise documentation as needed. Ensure all links and references work.
test_strategy: Perform a full onboarding run-through. Solicit feedback from another team member if possible. Confirm that a working environment is achieved solely from the documentation.
